items.title: The isomorphism space of two objects of an algebraic stack is locally of finite type
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the isomorphism space of two objects of an algebraic stack over a common test object is an algebraic space locally of finite type over that test object (author lemma at source lines 277-283, label lemma-isom-locally-finite-type). The proof (source lines 285-308) exhibits the isomorphism space as a fibre product involving the diagonal of the stack and transfers local finite type from the diagonal (proof lines 285-307). The fibre product description is the substance. H3.
